name: compound-intelligence
description: Experimental leadership coaching with manual case continuity, source-grounded methods and optional TypeSafe/Jev assistance.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the right leadership tool, understand it, and learn from practice.
interface.longDescription: One context-first skill, 21 internal book-grounded cards, optional typed routing and review, rehearsal, and consent-based learning. Does not make personnel decisions.
defaultPrompt: Help me think through this management situation and explain the tool you choose.
Coach me through a difficult conversation.
Help me learn from what happened without overgeneralizing.
